verdict.rationale: The only support is community evidence. An older comment says 'most of the product is open-source', and a community fork of the legacy GitBook CLI points to readable, forkable source. Other community reports say GitBook moved everything to its SaaS and 'abandoned open source spirit', with the CLI no longer under active development, so only a deprecated legacy component appears to be open. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an open-source license, public source for the current hosted platform, and an identified license or repository.
